Class BurstPar

  • Constructor Details

    • BurstPar

      public BurstPar(DistributionContainer contA, DistributionContainer contB)
      It creates a new burst parameter. It accepts two DistributionContainer containing the value distribution A and its parameter, and the value distribution B and its parameter, respectively.
      Parameters:
      contA - the DistributionContainer containing the value distribution A and its parameter
      contB - the DistributionContainer containing the value distribution B and its parameter
